mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation index above 0.3% triggers a preemptive equity risk premium as investors anticipate future rate hikes, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 0.3% in the current month
failure_condition: Over a 12-month window, 20-day forward returns during inflation spikes are not statistically different from zero (t-test p > 0.05), or CPIAUCSL does not exceed 0.3% in at least 4 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly rise in PAYEMS labor cost index exceeding 0.5% signals wage pressures that outpace productivity, prompting a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 60 trading days as profit expectations rise.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by more than 0.5% month-over-month for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: Across 5-year windows where PAYEMS shows persistent wage growth >0.5%, 60-day forward returns are non-positive on average (mean < 0).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp contraction in INDPRO manufacturing index below 50 signals supply-side weakness that elevates uncertainty, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls below 50 in the current month
failure_condition: During INDPRO <50 episodes, 20-day forward returns remain non-negative in >70% of cases (empirical frequency).

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive monthly increase in HOUST retail sales above 2% for two months indicates resilient consumer demand, which is associated with a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases by >2% month-over-month for two consecutive months
failure_condition: In regimes with strong demand signals (HOUST >2% MoM x2), 20-day forward returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS rises above 4.5% for the first time in a quarter, the anticipation of tighter policy compresses equity discount rates, producing a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.5% in the current quarter
failure_condition: During FEDFUNDS >4.5% episodes, 60-day forward returns are not persistently negative (mean > 0 over 3 quarters).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous monthly decline in both UNRATE unemployment rate and PAYEMS labor costs below 5% and 2% respectively indicates a tight labor market, which drives a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 5% AND PAYEMS < 2% in the current month
failure_condition: During joint UNRATE<5% & PAYEMS<2% episodes, 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A prolonged monthly decline in RSAFS industrial production index of more than 3% for three consecutive months signals a supply shock that elevates risk premia, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS decreases by >3% month-over-month for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: During RSAFS >3% monthly declines, 60-day forward returns remain non-negative in >50% of episodes (frequency test).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in GDPC1 GDP growth index below -1% for two consecutive quarters, without a corresponding drop in CPIAUCSL inflation, suggests a recessionary cycle that depresses equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 < -1% for two consecutive quarters AND CPIAUCSL < 0.2% growth in the same quarters
regime_hint: recessionary GDP growth without inflation acceleration
failure_condition: During such GDP recessions, 20-day forward returns are not persistently negative (mean > 0 over 6 months).
